name: sc-pick-after-status
description: Round 2+ strategy phase start from the status phase (the last 'Ready For Strategy Phase' / 'Start Strategy Phase' press) posts the first pick mid-interaction. Capture read the pre-interaction save (statusHomework), so StrategyCardPickKind.obsolete closed the fresh pick and the speaker had nothing to answer (live pbd229 10:46 round 3 and 10:12 round 2, pbd223 rounds 2+3, pbd188 round 3: STALL 'round N strategy active=<speaker>'). The pick must be an open strategy_card.pick for the speaker (letnev). Base pbd229 undo 370 (statusHomework); the fork has no reaction registry for the homework message, so the phase is started with the status-advance button (same StartPhaseService path).
